purpose: User-authorized P5 continuation: actual subscription-only organization and design pilot using known P4 evidence. No new numerical experiments or scientific performance claim.
basis: Twenty aggregate model minutes permit roughly five four-minute role sessions, or more shorter turns, with shared charging across participants. Four minutes allows reading, task/discussion records and a snapshotted artifact; it is a pilot cap, not a production research default. Existing per-session cleanup headroom remains inside the allowance.
exceedance: Pause at the owning runtime/Control boundary, retain role journal and all records/costs. No automatic retry, allowance increase, provider change or paid fallback. Unresolved previous runtime prevents another session.
